frozen_replay.statement: Replayed first, before any Explorer request: the recipes below, taken from the frozen agent history by the fixed replay rule. Each uses one discovery slot and one agent episode and no Explorer request. A source found by one is a history replay of that row, never independent discovery. A replay source goes through the normal loop (reproduction, reduction, diagnosis, candidates) before the next slot; if the campaign's candidate requests (at most 4) are used up there, discovery ends and later replays and Explorer slots do not run.
frozen_replay.rule: History replay rule (faultlab-history-replay/v1). From the plan's frozen agent history, a recipe row is replayed only if it has at least one scheduled fault, at least 2 verified episodes, every verified episode fired every scheduled fault, and at least 2 of every 3 verified episodes ended in VIOLATION. Eligible rows are ordered by violation share (highest first), then verified episodes (most first), then their order in the history; at most 3 are replayed. Each replay runs that row's recipe (the same order-aware schedule; a development case's public recipe, otherwise the listed faults with seed 0) as one discovery slot and one agent episode, with no Explorer request, before any Explorer slot. A replay becomes a source exactly as any discovery pick does (completed, every fault fired, VIOLATION). A result from it is a history replay of that row, never independent discovery.
